name: Component registry
description: A registry for agentic components, shaped like the Windows Registry (ADR-0063). Layers from any number of sources (a git branch, tag or commit; one .layer file over http(s) with bearer, header or basic log-in, the secret through dcf-secret and never over plain http without allow-insecure; a folder or mounted file share; a folder in the cloud folder, from the cloud-folder Feature; the rows of a SQLite or PostgreSQL table or query, rendered into a .layer file, the password through dcf-secret into the client's environment only) are fetched into local layer copies (version first, so an unchanged layer is skipped; offline, the last good copy is used and said) and merged by value type into one resolved view for who you are (COMPONENT_REGISTRY_WHOAMI, a path such as /Corp/MyDepartment/team/me): value replaces, list combines (!item takes out), text stacks in layer order (under a heading per layer, or none with the layer key heading: false), a skill's name and description values go into its SKILL.md front matter, ref points at another path; the higher layer wins, the more specific scope inside a layer, a locked key beats both, and a permission key comes from a component's lowest layer only. dcf-registry resolve and dcf-registry explain <path> [--uses] [--color auto|always|never] (task component-registry:resolve, :explain); release 1 resolves skills, and dcf-registry handover gives them to a CLI's adapter (agent-adapter-<cli> skills; Claude Code: its personal skills folder, live in running sessions), which the participant component (claude-code participants: true) does at every agent's start; a view is kept per who-you-are path, so agents with different paths each get their own skills (split, shared or off per agent), and /registry-refresh refreshes the calling agent. From 1.6.0 it also resolves agent definitions (agents/<name>: model and skills only, which replace the agents list's; the registry never sets an agent's identity, lease, folder, args or permissions), which the participant component reads at each agent's start. From 1.7.0 a layer can carry namespace: <name> (a public or community source): its components become <name>:<component>, merge only with layers of the same namespace and never reach the Operator's own; a namespaced skill is handed over as <name>--<skill>. From 1.11.0 (ADR-0077) each vendor's files are rendered from Jinja templates by minijinja-cli (one pinned static binary, checked against its sha256 at build) at every hand-over: templates are components (templates/<vendor>/<file>.j2 in a layer) that a higher layer replaces whole, changes one block of with extends, or adds to, under the same layer precedence, locks and namespaces; the built-in base layer ships Claude Code's and (2.1.0) Copilot CLI's SKILL.md template, which reproduces the resolved skill byte for byte; dcf-registry render previews and explain templates/<vendor> says whose template won. A built-in base layer ships the utility skills /registry-refresh, /registry-explain and /registry-remember (appends to the layer marked writable: true). The layer list is .devcontainer/registry.yml (option registryFile, COMPONENT_REGISTRY_FILE). Layer copies and the resolved view live owner-only in a named volume at COMPONENT_REGISTRY_STATE_DIR=/var/lib/devcontainer-features/component-registry, made usable by component-registry-setup at start. Bash, awk and sed, and minijinja-cli, the one download at build.

registryFile.description: The layer list, relative to the repository root (or absolute): which layers, at which paths, from which sources. Shared and committed; it never says who you are. COMPONENT_REGISTRY_FILE in .env or the environment overrides it without a rebuild.

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).
